It is the largest stadium in Syria, and is currently used mostly for football matches.  It serves as a home ground of Al-Ittihad football club.  It also hosted some home games of the Syrian football team.  The stadium was opened in 2007 and holds 75.000 spectators.  The venue is located near the al-Hamadaniah Sports City in the southern districts of Aleppo.
